ai.title: The Millennium Group of Schools Launches 'Millennium AI Creators Championship 2026' to Inspire India's Next Generation of Responsible AI Creators
ai.description: New Delhi [India], August 17: The Millennium Group of Schools, one of India's leading K-12 institutions, today announced the launch of the Millennium AI Creators Championship 2026, a first-of-its-kind national initiative designed to inspire school students to harness Artificial Intelligence responsibly while nurturing human creativity, innovation and future-ready skills. Open to students from Grades 5 to 12 across schools in India, the championship is free to participate, with registrations opening on 15th August 2026 and entries being accepted until 31st August 2026. The winners of the nationwide competition will be announced on 12th September 2026.
ai.title_cn: 千禧学校集团推出“2026年千禧人工智能创作者锦标赛”，激励印度下一代负责任的人工智能创作者
ai.description_cn: 新德里[印度]，8月17日：印度领先的K-12机构之一千禧学校集团今天宣布启动2026年千禧人工智能创作者锦标赛，这是一项史无前例的全国性举措，旨在激励学生负责任地利用人工智能，同时培养人类创造力、创新和面向未来的技能。该锦标赛向印度各学校5至12年级的学生开放，可免费参加，报名日期为2026年8月15日，参赛作品截止日期为2026年8月31日。全国比赛的获胜者将于2026年9月12日公布。

ai.title: Dubai launches first accredited Bachelor of Music programme with AI focus; course to begin in September
ai.description: Dubai is set to offer its first accredited Bachelor of Music programme starting September 2026. This new course focuses on contemporary and electronic music, covering production and business. Students will gain practical experience in professional studios and work on industry projects. Artificial intelligence in music creation will also be a key part of the curriculum. SAE University College Dubai is accepting applications now for this exciting opportunity.
ai.title_cn: 迪拜推出首个以人工智能为重点的认可音乐学士课程;课程将于9月开始
ai.description_cn: 迪拜将于2026年9月开始提供首个经过认证的音乐学士课程。这门新课程重点关注当代和电子音乐，涵盖制作和商业。学生将在专业工作室和行业项目中获得实践经验。音乐创作中的人工智能也将成为课程的关键部分。迪拜AE大学学院现在正在接受这一令人兴奋的机会的申请。
